name: Ample Classes Are Full-Reduction Closed
statement: For an ample class $C\subseteq Q_E$ and any coordinate set $T\subseteq E$, the full reduction $C^T$ consisting of placements of the $T$-cubes contained in $C$ is ample. Whenever $C^T$ is nonempty, its one-inclusion graph is connected.
proof: A support $U\subseteq E\setminus T$ is strongly shattered by $C^T$ exactly when $U\cup T$ is strongly shattered by $C$. Reduction closure for ample classes therefore preserves equality of shattered and strongly shattered supports. Every nonempty ample class is a partial cube and hence connected in its one-inclusion graph.
